systemArchitectures.technology: High-Pressure Supercritical CO2 Micro-Fluidic Hydrodynamic Focusing Cross-Flow Chamber (120–280 bar, 35–50°C) with 32 Parallel Micro-Channels and In-Line Desorption Decompression Loop
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Solid Forged AISI 316L Stainless Steel Flow Manifold (Ra ≤ 0.28 µm electropolished) with Kalrez 6230 Perfluoroelastomer Sanitary High-Pressure Seals and Single-Crystal Sapphire Micro-Fluidic Windows
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual ASME UV-Stamped Rupture Discs (320 bar), Dynamic Micro-Differential Backpressure Regulators, Automated Aseptic CIP/SIP Cycles, and In-Line DLS Particle Size Laser Interlock
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship industrial continuous high-pressure supercritical CO2 micro-fluidic liposome extrusion plant. Replaces conventional high-shear homogenization and organic solvent evaporation with dense-phase CO2 micro-fluidic hydrodynamic focusing, generating monodisperse sub-100nm unilamellar liposomes with >97% encapsulation efficiency and zero volatile organic solvent residues.

systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Cleanroom Formulation Skid (ISO 14644-1 Class 5 / EU GMP Annex 1 / USP <788> Particulate Matter / ASME BPE)
systemArchitectures.technology: Micro-Machined Synthetic Sapphire Hydrodynamic Focusing Flow Cell with Dual Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS) & Multi-Angle Light Scattering (MALS) In-Line Sizing
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Hastelloy C-22 & Pharmaceutical Grade Titanium Ti-6Al-4V Micro-Manifold with Ultra-Pure Fluoropolymer Gaskets and Zero-Deadleg Diaphragm Sampling Ports
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Aseptic Sterile Barrier Enclosure, Overpressure Rapid Micro-Vent Valving, and Multi-Wavelength Optical Density Bubble Detection
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered for high-potency sterile pharmaceutical and advanced clinical nutrition payloads (mRNA, bioactive peptides, and delicate enzymes). Features atomic-smooth sapphire channel walls ensuring zero wall friction, zero shear stress, and near-zero polydispersity (PDI < 0.06).

systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L Sanitary Core with PTFE Backup O-Rings and Sanitary Tri-Clamp Process Connections

systemArchitectures.description: Optimized for high-volume dietary supplement brands producing liposomal curcumin, resveratrol, glutathione, and quercetin beverages. Delivers up to 1,450 L/h of golden, crystal-clear, water-soluble liposomal concentrate with 100% clean-label lecithin.

bioactivePayloads.name: Standardized Curcuminoids (95% Pure Curcumin, Demethoxycurcumin & Bisdemethoxycurcumin)
bioactivePayloads.thermalHeatSensitivity: High (Thermal heating > 60°C causes rapid yellow-to-brown hydrolytic degradation and loss of antioxidant capacity)
bioactivePayloads.targetEncapsulationDomain: Phospholipid Hydrocarbon Acyl Chain Core (Hydrophobic Bilayer Midplane)
bioactivePayloads.description: Highly lipophilic golden polyphenol with powerful anti-inflammatory and free radical scavenging activities. Naturally insoluble in water (0.6 µg/mL). Supercritical CO2 plasticizes phospholipid acyl chains, enabling solvent-free intercalation into the liposomal bilayer with >98% efficiency and 18.5x oral bioavailability enhancement.

bioactivePayloads.name: Reduced L-Glutathione (GSH Master Intracellular Antioxidant Tripeptide)
bioactivePayloads.thermalHeatSensitivity: Extremely Critical (Oxidizes rapidly to inactive disulfide GSSG upon contact with oxygen, heat, or mechanical shear)
bioactivePayloads.targetEncapsulationDomain: Aqueous Core Lumen (Encapsulated Inside Unilamellar Vesicle Center)
bioactivePayloads.description: The master endogenous cellular antioxidant. In unprotected oral ingestion, stomach hydrochloric acid and peptidases break down GSH before absorption. scCO2-MLE entraps GSH inside protective aqueous liposomal cores at physiological temperatures without oxidation to GSSG, retaining >99% free thiol groups.

bioactivePayloads.name: Trans-Resveratrol (Pure 3,5,4'-Trihydroxystilbene from Polygonum cuspidatum)
bioactivePayloads.thermalHeatSensitivity: Very High (Light, air, and heat trigger immediate irreversible isomerization to inactive cis-resveratrol)
bioactivePayloads.targetEncapsulationDomain: Glycerol Backbone / Polar Headgroup Interfacial Bilayer Shell
bioactivePayloads.description: Potent sirtuin-activating polyphenol susceptible to photochemical cis-isomerization and rapid first-pass liver glucuronidation. Nanoliposomal encapsulation stabilizes the active trans-isomer against UV photo-degradation and extends circulating plasma half-life by 7.8-fold.

bioactivePayloads.name: Pure L-Ascorbic Acid (Concentrated Water-Soluble Vitamin C Formulation)
bioactivePayloads.thermalHeatSensitivity: High (Catalytic oxidation accelerated by heat, air, copper, and iron traces into dehydroascorbic acid and diketogulonic acid)
bioactivePayloads.targetEncapsulationDomain: Central Aqueous Cavity (High Osmotic Lumen Concentration)
bioactivePayloads.description: Essential water-soluble antioxidant. In commercial beverage manufacturing, dissolved oxygen and thermal pasteurization deplete up to 40% of natural Vitamin C. scCO2 micro-fluidic encapsulation encloses concentrated ascorbic acid inside anaerobic lipid bilayers, shielding it from transition metals and light.

bioactivePayloads.name: Quercetin Dihydrate (Bioflavonoid Antioxidant & Mast Cell Stabilizer)
bioactivePayloads.thermalHeatSensitivity: Moderate (Insoluble crystals precipitate upon cooling, poor gut absorption)
bioactivePayloads.description: Dietary bioflavonoid celebrated for respiratory and immune defense support. Its poor water solubility severely limits gastrointestinal uptake. Dense-phase scCO2 eliminates crystal lattice barriers, dispersing quercetin molecularly inside lecithin bilayers to boost human oral bioavailability by 22-fold.

bioactivePayloads.name: Uncertified Chloroform/Methanol Thin-Film Hydration Slurry (Severe Hazard)
bioactivePayloads.payloadClass: Hazardous Non-Compliant Toxic Solvent Mixture (USP <467> Class 2 & 1 Solvents)
bioactivePayloads.targetEncapsulationDomain: Contaminated Bilayer Defect Zones (Channel Membrane Disruption)
bioactivePayloads.description: CRITICAL REGULATORY VIOLATION: Conventional legacy Bangham lipid film hydration contaminated with residual chloroform and methanol solvents (>650 ppm vs FDA/USP 60 ppm ceiling). Causes high-shear vesicle aggregation (PDI > 0.45), acute membrane leakage, and severe liver toxicity.

lipidMatrices.name: Purified High-Purity Soy Phosphatidylcholine (Soy PC-95, Tm = -10°C)
lipidMatrices.fluidityIndex: High Fluidity Liquid-Crystalline Bilayer at Operating Temps (35–45°C)
lipidMatrices.description: Natural unsaturated phospholipid composed primarily of linoleic (18:2) and oleic (18:1) acyl chains. Exhibits sub-ambient phase transition temperature (Tm = -10°C), facilitating lightning-fast self-assembly into ultra-small, flexible nanoliposomes (45–65 nm) under micro-fluidic cross-flow.

lipidMatrices.name: Hydrogenated Soy Phosphatidylcholine (HSPC) + 30 mol% Cholesterol (Tm = 54°C)
lipidMatrices.lipidType: Saturated Phospholipid & Sterol Rigid Gel Matrix
lipidMatrices.description: Composed of fully saturated stearic (18:0) and palmitic (16:0) chains stabilized with 30 mol% cholesterol. Creates an exceptionally dense, low-permeability bilayer that resists gastric acid dissolution (pH 1.2–2.0), ensuring targeted intestinal delivery of sensitive peptides and vitamins.

lipidMatrices.name: Clean-Label Non-GMO Sunflower Phosphatidylcholine & DOPC Blend (Tm = -17°C)
lipidMatrices.description: Premium non-GMO, allergen-free botanical lecithin extracted exclusively from sunflower seeds. Highly preferred for clean-label USDA Organic dietary supplements and functional beverages, avoiding common soy allergen declarations while maintaining sub-80nm vesicle size.

lipidMatrices.name: DPPC : DMPG : Cholesterol (60:20:20 Molar Ratio, Negative Zeta Potential)
lipidMatrices.fluidityIndex: Controlled Gel-Phase with Strong Electrostatic Repulsion (ζ = -38 mV)
lipidMatrices.description: Engineered pharmaceutical lipid formulation incorporating 20 mol% anionic 1,2-dimyristoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoglycerol (DMPG). Imparts a strong negative zeta potential (ζ = -35 to -42 mV), preventing vesicle aggregation, flocculation, and coalescence over 24+ months of shelf storage.

microfluidicChambers.name: Planar 2D Hydrodynamic Focusing Micro-Nozzle (50 µm Orifice, Cross-Flow Geometry)
microfluidicChambers.description: Precision micro-machined cross-junction where two sheath streams of aqueous buffer hydrodynamically focus an organic lipid/scCO2 center stream into a micron-thin liquid sheet. Intermolecular diffusion occurs within 1.2 milliseconds, driving instantaneous, reproducible vesicle closure.

microfluidicChambers.name: Staggered Herringbone 3D Chaotic Advection Micro-Mixer (SHM, 75 µm Depth)
microfluidicChambers.description: Features asymmetric grooved micro-channels on channel floors and ceilings that generate alternating rotational micro-vortices. Induces exponential chaotic fluid stretching and folding, collapsing diffusive distance and achieving near-perfect vesicle size uniformity (PDI < 0.06).

microfluidicChambers.name: Coaxial 3D Annular Fused-Silica Capillary Injector (Non-Contact Sheath Flow)
microfluidicChambers.description: Suspends the lipid/scCO2 core completely in the center of a circular aqueous sheath flow without touching channel walls. Completely eliminates lipid wall-fouling, polymer deposition, and nozzle clogging during continuous 24/7 manufacturing campaigns.

microfluidicChambers.name: Defective Unfocused Sharp-Edged Orifice (Severe Cavitation Hazard)
microfluidicChambers.description: CRITICAL DEFECT: Lacks hydrodynamic focusing geometry. Generates uncontrolled turbulent shear jets and localized acoustic cavitation, shattering assembled bilayers into large multi-lamellar vesicles (d_h > 350 nm, PDI > 0.40) with massive payload leakage.

letdownMechanisms.name: Multi-Stage Heated PEEK Micro-Capillary Letdown Restrictor (Controlled dP/dt = 12 bar/s)
letdownMechanisms.antiJouleThomsonHeating: Automated Induction Thermal Collar (Prevents Dry Ice Crystallization)
letdownMechanisms.description: Decompresses the dense-phase mixture gradually through micro-metered capillary passages, avoiding ultrasonic shockwaves or sudden boiling that could shear nanoliposome membranes or cause payload expulsion.

letdownMechanisms.name: Sanitary Counter-Current Packed Stripping Column with Nitrogen Sweep Gas
letdownMechanisms.mechanismType: Exhaustive In-Line Degassing & Gas Stripping Column
letdownMechanisms.description: Strikes residual dissolved carbon dioxide down below 0.05 volumes CO2 using an inert sterile nitrogen counter-current sweep, ensuring finished beverage concentrates do not foam, pressurize, or rupture aseptic packaging.

letdownMechanisms.name: Supersonic De Laval Expansion Nozzle with Cyclonic Liquid Separator
letdownMechanisms.description: Employs high-speed supersonic isenthalpic gas flashing into a cyclonic collection vessel. Ideal for robust liposomal formulations requiring instant gas separation at high flow rates.

regulatoryStandards.scope: Current Good Manufacturing Practice in Manufacturing, Packaging, Labeling, or Holding Operations for Dietary Supplements and Human Food
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Requires validated process sanitation, batch-to-batch chemical identity verification, absence of hazardous solvent contaminants, and continuous electronic parameter recordkeeping.

regulatoryStandards.standard: FDA 21 CFR § 184.1240 (GRAS Status for Carbon Dioxide)
regulatoryStandards.scope: Direct Food Additive / Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS) Affirmation
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Dense-phase and supercritical carbon dioxide affirmed GRAS for food and dietary supplement extraction and micro-encapsulation when conforming to CGA G-6.2 beverage-grade purity (≥ 99.95% CO2).

regulatoryStandards.scope: Limits for Organic Solvent Residues in Pharmaceuticals and Dietary Supplements
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Mandates strict thresholds: Class 1 solvents (chloroform, benzene) strictly prohibited; Class 2 solvents (methanol, hexane) capped at ≤ 60–290 ppm. scCO2-MLE achieves 0.0 ppm residual organic solvents.

regulatoryStandards.scope: Rules for Construction of High-Pressure Vessels and Sanitary Micro-Fluidic Manifolds
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Full volumetric radiographic and ultrasonic inspection of all forged pressure boundaries up to 320 bar with dual ASME UV-stamped pressure safety relief valves.

regulatoryStandards.standard: 3-A Sanitary Standards 60-01 & 61-01 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic
regulatoryStandards.authority: 3-A Sanitary Standards Inc. & European Hygienic Engineering & Design Group
regulatoryStandards.scope: Sanitary Fittings and Continuous In-Line Fluid Processing Equipment for Food Contact
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Product contact metallurgy in AISI 316L (Ra ≤ 0.28 µm electropolished), complete drainability with zero deadlegs (L/D < 1.5), and full compatibility with automated clean-in-place (CIP) and steam-in-place (SIP) cycles.
